notes: §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3 forbids a) SPACE, alphanumeric edited or alphabetic to numeric/numeric edited, b) numeric literal, ZERO, numeric or numeric edited to alphabetic, c) a noninteger numeric literal or item to alphanumeric or alphanumeric edited, and says 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric' and 'All other elementary moves are legal'. MoveBinder.MoveCategoryLegality asks MoveTable16.Validity: ShapeRefusal/MoveValidity.FigurativeRefusal refuse SPACE into numeric and ZERO into alphabetic at every edition, Table16Refusal refuses a)-c) (COBOL0819), and FigurativeAssociation.GateSr5 (asked by VersionConformancePass.GateMove) admits QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE and ALL literal into numeric items at 85 while refusing them at 2023 (COBOL0902). Probes at --std 85: all twelve a)-c) violations refused COBOL0819 (MOVE SPACE TO 9(3)/ZZ9, XXBXX and A(5) to numeric, 12/ZERO/9(3)/ZZ9 to A(5), 1.5 and S9(3)V99 to X(5)/XXBXX, PIC PP9 to X(8)); legal half runs: QUOTE->9(3) '"""', ALL "7" '777', ZERO->X(5) '00000', ZERO->ZZ9 '  0', SPACE->A(5)/XXBXX, S9(3) -12 ->X(5) '012  ' (sign not moved), 99PP->X(5) '1200 ', 123->XXBXX '12 3 ', $$9.99->9(3) de-edits to '045', S9(18)->X(20), group ODO and ref-mod sends; HIGH-VALUE/LOW-VALUE/QUOTES/ALL "AB" to numeric accepted at 85, refused COBOL0902 at 2023 (ALL "AB" also at 2002). d) is a level-1 limit; the compiler implements Nucleus level 2, where de-editing is legal. Witness: MOVE SPACE TO PIC 9(3) refused COBOL0819.

next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) corrected the category list, 'categories: numeric, alphabetic, numeric edited, alphanumeric edited' gaining 'alphanumeric' (a typographical error); the requirement is as it was. §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3: 'All other figurative constants belong to the category alphanumeric' and 'e. All other elementary moves are legal', so MOVE QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE or ALL literal to a numeric or numeric edited item is legal 1985 (§1985:VI.6.19.4 GR4: 'as if the sending operand were described as an unsigned numeric integer'). §2023:14.9.25.3 SR5 refuses it: 'the move of an alphanumeric figurative constant (SPACE, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, ALL "literal", or ALL symbolic-character) to either a numeric item or a numeric-edited item is prohibited', save ALL digits to an integer item; §2023:E.2 lists the removal. The rest is kept: the elementary move (§2023:14.9.25.4 GR4), literal and figurative-constant categories (§2023:14.9.25.4 GR7 with Table 17; ZERO as 'the numeric value', §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR4), item categories (§2023:13.18.40.4 GR3), ZERO not to alphabetic (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR6) and prohibitions a) to c) in Table 16 (§2023:14.9.25.3 SR10). d) is the level 1 limit, and SPACE as 'alphabetic' (Table 17: alphanumeric) allows the same moves.
